final_report.summary: Within the authorized fixed window (1789011776–1789012076 UTC, 2026-09-10 03:42:56–03:47:56Z) for integration m0-otel-20260909, the visible data show no checkout request failures. Window-scoped rate queries (`increase(...[5m])` evaluated at the window end) on checkout spans return 67.5 spans with STATUS_CODE_UNSET and 0 with STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and 0 error spans for both SERVER and CLIENT span kinds. Checkout's outbound gRPC client histogram counts all show rpc_grpc_status_code 0 (Convert 13.75, GetProduct 8.75, GetCart 5, EmptyCart 5, GetQuote 5, ShipOrder 5, Charge 5), with status 2 (UNKNOWN) Charge = 0; checkout's gRPC server counts show 5 for status 0 and 0 for status 13. The returned trace set (5 traces, 248 spans) reports 0 error spans by visible tags for every visible service including checkout (66 spans). Displayed logs (cart, frontend-proxy) show no error-severity records and no 5xx proxy responses. However, checkout has no log source, the trace view is a biased sample (20 of 248 spans), and backend log hits exceed displayed rows (cart 54, frontend-proxy 128), so the evidence supports 'no observed failures' rather than certification that no failures occurred; no baseline or SLO was supplied.

claims.text: Window-scoped rate query `increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout"}[5m])` at evaluation time 1789012076 returns checkout STATUS_CODE_UNSET = 67.5 and STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 (increase values are extrapolated, not unique request counts).
Grouped by span kind, checkout's window increase is SPAN_KIND_SERVER UNSET 5 / ERROR 0, SPAN_KIND_CLIENT UNSET 52.5 / ERROR 0, SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL 5, SPAN_KIND_PRODUCER 5.

Checkout's outbound gRPC client duration histogram (+Inf bucket increase over 5m) shows all calls with rpc_grpc_status_code="0": Convert/oteldemo.CurrencyService 13.75, GetProduct/oteldemo.ProductCatalogService 8.75, GetCart 5 and EmptyCart 5 (oteldemo.CartService), GetQuote 5 and ShipOrder 5 (oteldemo.ShippingService), Charge/oteldemo.PaymentService 5; the only non-zero-status series, Charge with rpc_grpc_status_code="2", is 0. Bucket values are cumulative histogram buckets and increase is extrapolated.
Checkout's inbound gRPC server duration histogram (+Inf bucket increase over 5m) shows rpc_grpc_status_code="0" = 5 and rpc_grpc_status_code="13" = 0.

Service-wide span increase for the window shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 for checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment, load-generator, fraud-detection and accounting, with non-zero error status only for recommendation (1.25) and ad (1.25); currency reports STATUS_CODE_OK 13.75.

The returned trace set for the window contains 5 trace IDs and 248 spans with per-service error_spans_by_visible_tags = 0 for all visible services, including checkout (66 spans, max duration 66424 µs) and payment (10 spans); it is a biased sample of 20 displayed spans, omitting 234 spans.

Displayed sampled spans show successful checkout-path requests: load-generator POST http.status_code 200 -> frontend-proxy ingress 200 -> frontend POST /api/checkout 200 -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 (traces ef94f6ad35ad2a47fecf672989d8ad6f and 0486232d8e10ce9cb3fb014b79ef8ae0).

Cart logs for the window (newest-first, limit 20, 20 of 54 backend hits displayed) show only severity Information entries: GetCartAsync, AddItemAsync and EmptyCartAsync calls; no error-severity records are displayed.

frontend-proxy access logs for the window (limit 20, 18 of 128 backend hits displayed) show HTTP 200 for every displayed request except two 308 redirects (`GET /api/data/` at 03:47:33 and 03:47:29); no 5xx status appears in displayed rows.

Cart's EmptyCartAsync log entry at 2026-09-10T03:44:46.3211852Z carries trace_id 0486232d8e10ce9cb3fb014b79ef8ae0, which is one of the trace IDs in the window's returned trace set; cart log trace_id 78e17a0d6a3b4ab0e49f5e2499f609b9 matches the frontend-proxy `GET /api/cart` 200 access log record, showing log-trace alignment between those two sources. Neither record is attributable to a checkout span (returned trace set is aggregate, not per-trace, for checkout spans).

app_payment_transactions_total increases by ~4.9996 over the 5m range for service_name=payment in the window; the returned series exposes only the service_name label, so no success/failure breakdown is visible.

The visible absence of checkout errors is bounded: logs are available only for cart and frontend-proxy (no checkout log source), the trace projection displayed 20 of 248 spans and does not enumerate per-trace checkout membership, and displayed log rows cover 20 of 54 cart hits and 18 of 128 frontend-proxy hits — omitted records were not examined.

Provisional: the window appears to be a normal-operation period for checkout, since zero error-status spans, zero non-zero gRPC statuses on checkout client/server calls (except 0-valued series) and successful sampled checkout traces co-occur. This is correlation within the observed window only and is not a health or recovery certification.

Rejected on visible evidence for this window: a checkout payment RPC failure burst — the only series with a non-zero gRPC status label for checkout's Charge call (rpc_grpc_status_code="2") shows an increase of 0, and payment-related error status is 0 for both payment and checkout.

Rejected on visible evidence for this window: checkout HTTP/frontend-facing 5xx failures — no 5xx appears in the displayed frontend-proxy access rows and frontend shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 with POST /api/checkout returning 200 in the sampled traces.

Provisional: treat the non-zero error-status increases seen for recommendation (1.25) and ad (1.25), and the ad EventStream rpc_grpc_status_code="4" increase (1.24999), as separate follow-ups outside the checkout question rather than checkout failures; they were not escalated into checkout-path evidence in this run.

gaps: No checkout application logs exist among the available log sources (cart, frontend-proxy), so checkout-side exceptions/errors cannot be inspected directly for this window.

Trace evidence is a biased sample: 20 of 248 returned spans displayed, 5 trace IDs only, and checkout span counts (66) are aggregated over the returned trace set rather than per trace, so per-request checkout outcomes and total trace volume in the window are unknown.
Backend log hits exceed displayed rows (cart 54 total vs 20 displayed; frontend-proxy 128 total vs 18 displayed); statuses of omitted records were not observed.
app_payment_transactions_total returned without a status/label dimension, so payment transaction success vs failure mix in the window is unknown.
No SLO, error budget or comparison baseline was supplied, so no trend or health/recovery judgement is possible.
The 5m increase range covers the 300s window length only approximately at instant evaluation; no per-minute breakdown was retrieved to confirm the error-free character across every sub-interval.
next_steps: Enable or add a checkout log source (e.g. kubernetes/logs, grafana/loki, opensearch/logs, datadog/logs for the checkout container) so checkout-side errors can be read directly for this window.

Re-query the window with per-minute `rate`/`increase` series on traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} and on rpc_server/rpc_client histograms with non-zero rpc_grpc_status_code filters to confirm the zero-error result holds across sub-intervals.

Retrieve traces for individual checkout trace IDs and compare against cart/frontend-proxy log trace_ids to attribute specific checkout requests, rather than relying on the aggregate returned trace set.
Investigate the separately observed non-zero error rates for recommendation and ad as independent follow-ups, without attributing them to checkout.
